rule: Committed text, read with what reviewer_knew lists, the design above (4, 8 and 12 drafts by class, one per household, 6 per config) and each draft's own screen, could let a reader single out a draft's class. Committed text means the files git tracks at the lock commit outside data/truth, data/profiles, eval/runs and ledger. A draft is marked when that reading gives its class clearly better than the flags alone do (six drafts carry dropped:R001). Elimination counts only when every step is itself reading. Running or reverse-engineering code to rebuild what those four folders hold does not count, because reviewer_rule rules it out. Before the lock, two subagents working from the answer key independently marked the drafts, a third settled their disagreement, and the marking was checked again against everything this feature commits. The marked IDs are committed only as inferable_sha256, the SHA-256 of the salt, a colon, and the sorted IDs joined by commas; the salt and the IDs are in data/truth/review_inferable.json, gitignored until scoring. The report gives the shows catch rate without the marked drafts beside the full rate.

The same A-opus failure arithmetic makes d07 and d21 lean clean but not clearly; they are not skeptic points and stay unmarked.
